figures.finding: Trinidad and Tobago has no child-performer permit: a child under sixteen may not be employed or work in any public or private undertaking other than a family one, save school, vocational or technical work and, from fourteen, training integral to a course under the education minister's conditions; 'employment' covers any labour exercised by way of trade or for gain, to the child or anyone else. There is no exception for performing, so the bar reaches a child actor, writer or director working for gain alike (reading).

exceptions: from 14, training integral to a course

figures.applies: Children Act Chap. 46:01 (Act 12 of 2012) ss. 103, 105, 106, unofficial version to 31 December 2016 on laws.gov.tt.

sources.said: “employ” and “employment” include employment in any labour exercised by way of trade or for the purposes of gain, whether the gain be to the child or to any other person; ... 105. Subject to section 106, a child under the age of sixteen years shall not be employed or work in any public or private undertaking, or in any branch thereof, other than an undertaking, owned and controlled by members of the same family; and any person who employs any such child, commits an offence. ... 106. Section 105 shall not apply to work done by— (a) a child in school for general, vocational or technical education or in other training institutions; or (b) a child at least fourteen years of age in undertakings

figures.finding: No individual under eighteen may form or join in forming a company, nor be a director of any company, in Trinidad and Tobago.
figures.applies: Companies Act Chap. 81:01 ss. 8(2), 68(1), unofficial version on laws.gov.tt.

sources.said: (2) No individual who— (a) is less than eighteen years of age; ... shall form or join in the formation of a company under this Act. ... 68. (1) An individual who is prohibited by section 8(2) from forming or joining in the formation of a company shall not be a director of any company.

figures.finding: A person attains full age at eighteen in Trinidad and Tobago; how a minor's contract for creative work is made binding, and any set-aside of earnings, were not found (see blockers).
figures.applies: Age of Majority Act Chap. 46:06 s. 2, unofficial version on laws.gov.tt.

sources.said: a person shall attain full age on attaining the age of eighteen instead of on attaining the age of twenty-one
